title: How Reasoning Influences Intersectional Biases in Vision Language Models (Student Abstract)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the empirical frequency distributions of predicted occupations for face images across 7 racial groups from the FairFace dataset, and qualitatively analyzing the models' generated reasoning for stereotypical reliance on demographic or cultural identifiers (e.g., 'turban', 'dreadlocks').

Comparing the frequency of masculine-coded (e.g., Criminal, Business Owner) versus feminine-coded (e.g., Homemaker, Social Worker) occupation predictions for male and female face images, and examining the generated reasoning for post-hoc gender stereotypes.
Measuring the skewness and prediction disparities in joint occupation prediction and reasoning generation across 14 intersectional race-gender demographic subgroups.
